alternate_names: Siddh Tantra Peeth Shri Kal Bhairav Mandir
Shri Sidh Tantra Peeth Bhairav Baba Mandir
deities: Kaal Bhairav (Baba Bhairavnath), guardian deity of the Mahamaya Kaumari Shaktipeeth
festivals: Bhairav Janmotsav (with group marriages and social programmes in recent years, per local report)

history.dynasty: Unknown; current temple structure built by Baba Gyangiri Gosai (date not documented)
history.period: Age of the idol unknown; local sources call the shrine ancient
history.summary: The Bhairav temple at the entrance of Ratanpur town on the Bilaspur-Ratanpur road (right side), regarded as the guardian (rakshak) of the Adi Shakti Mahamaya Kaumari Shaktipeeth — devotees consider the Shaktipeeth pilgrimage complete only after darshan here. The fierce (raudra) idol is reported as 10 feet tall with 20 arms bearing weapons (some tourism sources say 9 feet — conflict flagged); it originally stood on an open platform before Baba Gyangiri Gosai built the temple around it. Legend holds the Bhairav murti was established as guardian when Sati's right shoulder fell at Ratanpur. CSV TOWN CORRECTION: the temple is at Ratanpur (Bilaspur district), not Bilaspur city. Not to be confused with the Kalbhairav shrine on the Mahamaya temple approach road. Coordinates are for the geocoded 'Shri Sidh Tantra Peeth Bhairav Baba Mandir' POI on NH-111 near Ratanpur (approximate match).

name: Baba Bhairavnath Temple
town_description: Ratanpur, ~25 km from Bilaspur on the Katghora road, was the capital of the Kalachuri kings of Dakshin Kosal and is called the 'city of ponds' for its historic tanks. It is a dense cluster of old temples, forts and palaces and is described locally as a city sacred in all four yugas.
tradition: Shaktism/Shaivism (Kaal Bhairav worship with tantra associations; the shrine is styled a Siddh Tantra Peeth)

travel.road: On the Bilaspur-Ratanpur road at the entrance of Ratanpur town

visitor_information.best_time: October to March; Navratri and Bhairav Jayanti are the main visiting occasions
visitor_information.opening_hours: Not published for this temple; typical village/small-town shrine hours. Verify locally.
